versions.content: Publish resources needed from AUTOSAR Services Type: valid Description: If a BSW module needs resources from AUTOSAR Services, the needs have to be described. Rationale: To allow the ECU Configuration activity of the AUTOSAR Services, the needs from BSW and Application SW Components have to be captured. 5 39 of 47  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 86: AUTOSAR_RS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Requirements on Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Dependencies:  Use Case: When a BSW module requires some NVRAM space it has to provide a description of the attributes this NVRAM has to have. Supporting Material: 
